stories.stat_label: years after a class raised her
stories.headline: A turtle raised by schoolkids 16 years ago just had babies
stories.summary: Zoo New England gives rare Blanding's turtle hatchlings to classrooms for a year, so they grow too big for predators. Small Fry, raised at a Concord school 16 years ago, now has hatchlings of her own.
stories.why: Kids helped save a turtle, and now she's helping her species recover.

stories.headline: A drug regrew worn knee cartilage in old mice
stories.summary: Stanford scientists blocked an ageing protein called 15-PGDH. Old mice regrew smooth knee cartilage, and human cartilage from knee replacements began making new tissue too. Human trials are still needed.
stories.why: It could one day mean fewer knee and hip replacements.

stories.stat_label: years old, from the Ur III era
stories.headline: 15 clay tablets reveal farm life 4,000+ years ago in Iraq
stories.summary: Researchers studied 15 cuneiform tablets in the Iraq Museum, dated 2112 to 2004 BCE. Most come from Umma and record land, irrigation, grain and workers.
stories.why: They show how one of the first states fed its people.

stories.stat_label: MWh battery planned at a coal plant
stories.headline: Australia's biggest coal plant site may get its biggest battery
stories.summary: Origin Energy wants to double the battery being built next to the Eraring coal station to 1,200 MW and 8,600 MWh. That would be Australia's largest by far.
stories.why: Big batteries let solar and wind power keep the lights on after dark.

fun_fact: Blanding's turtle hatchlings are so small that predators as little as chipmunks can eat them.
